scripts.web:build: rm -rf dist/web && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.build.json && node apps/web/scripts/cli.mjs
scripts.web:build:release: rm -rf dist/web && node apps/web/scripts/release-check.mjs && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.build.json && node apps/web/scripts/cli.mjs --release && node apps/web/scripts/verify-output.mjs --release
scripts.web:build:preview: rm -rf dist/web && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.build.json && node apps/web/scripts/cli.mjs --preview
